product_metadata.title: INSE Cordless Vacuum, 12KPa Powerful Vacuum Cleaner with 160W Motor, 4-in-1 Stick Vacuum, Rechargeable Handheld Vacuum Cleaner for Home Hard Floor Carpet Pet Hair-N6
features: 160W Brush Digital Motor: Generates 12kpa Extreme Powerful Suction on Max Mode, quickly picks up pet hair, Debris, dusts from Multi Surfaces, cordless vacuum performs well on all kinds of hard floors, carpet, stairs and windowsills, sofa and bed, desk and curtain, etc

5 Stages Full Sealed Filtration System: Fully sealed filtration system separates clean air and dust efficiently without leakage, Plus high-density HEPA which removes up to 99.99% of microscopic dust particles as small as 0.1 microns, this vacuum cleaner makes the exhaust air cleaner, can effectively prevent secondary pollution. HEPA is reusable and can be cleaned with the cleaning tool. (After cleaning the HEPA can solve the problem of reduced suction)

Low Noise Design and Light Weight: ultra-quiet operation sound avoids annoying noise, friendly to your baby and pet. weighing only 3.3lbs easily converts from stick vac to a handheld vacuum, the extendable tube and multiple attachments also make it easy to vacuum curtains, ceilings and high surfaces, meeting you floor-to-ceiling cleaning needs

Detachable Long-lasting: quick charge and long run time; cordless vacuum cleaner have 2 speed modes(Standard Mode: 45 mins; MAX Mode: 15 mins); continuous operation without risk of high temperature due to AFDPT (cooling system with air flow design patent technology ), safe to use at home and in car. Note: low charge will affect the size of suction

Rotatable Motorized Brush with LED Light: 2 Motorized Brush is swivel 150 degrees, the stiff one for carpets (low pile) and the soft one with antistatic carbon fiber bristle for hard floors include tiles; The front LED lights make it easily to see the dust under furniture or in hard-to-reach conner, the Stick Vacuum makes cleaning these areas an absolute breeze, Giving you the very best cleaning performance

What You Get - INSE vacuum cleaner, motorized brush head,stiff roller brush, soft roller brush, retractable metal tube, long crevice, oval brush for fabric surface, 2 HEPA filters, charging base with mains charger, 2 in 1 cleaner tool for cleaning hair from the roller, instruction manual, service card and 7/24 INSE customer service
